description: This file defines the class `AOPAssignManager` responsible for managing assignment strategies (e.g., round robin, least busy, random, single user) for handling cases within the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for determining the next user to assign a case, managing assignment options, and integrating with external modules such as SecurityGroups and ACLRoles.

classes.name: AOPAssignManager
classes.description: A class that manages the assignment of cases to users based on various distribution strategies such as round robin, least busy, random, or a fixed single user.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the assignment manager, setting distribution method based on inbound email options or default configuration and retrieving assignable users.

methods.name: isAOPFallback
methods.description: Determines if the fallback distribution method should be used based on the provided method string.

methods.name: getDistributionOptions
methods.description: Retrieves the distribution options either from global configuration or inbound email options.

methods.name: getRoleUsers
methods.description: Fetches users linked to a specific role.

methods.name: getAssignableUsers
methods.description: Obtains the list of users eligible for assignment based on the distribution options.

methods.name: getSingleUser
methods.description: Returns the user ID set for single user distribution.

methods.name: getLeastBusyCounts
methods.description: Calculates and returns the count of cases assigned to each user to determine the least busy user.

methods.name: getLeastBusyUser
methods.description: Selects the user with the fewest assigned cases.

methods.name: updateLeastBusy
methods.description: Updates the count of cases assigned to a user after assignment.

methods.name: getRandomUser
methods.description: Selects a user at random from the list of assignable users.

methods.name: getNextAssignedUser
methods.description: Determines the next user to assign a case to based on the configured distribution method.

methods.name: getRoundRobinUser
methods.description: Retrieves the next user in the round robin sequence.

methods.name: setLastRoundRobinUser
methods.description: Stores the last user in the round robin sequence in session and cache files.
